name: Eunos North
summary: North of Eunos toward Kembangan / Geylang East edges — EWL-adjacent denser living with food energy and practical mid-town hops.
body: Eunos North is the shortlist when EWL adjacency and denser food texture matter more than quiet landed weekends. The pocket sits north of Eunos toward Kembangan / Geylang East edges; housing mixes HDB, mid-age condos, and walk-ups. Expats land here for car-light hops to Bugis / City Hall and ActiveSG catchment without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: late food noise, facade washing calendars on older blocks, and confusing Eunos vs Eunos North shortlists. Compare with Kaki Bukit Fringe for quieter industrial-edge DTL living, Paya Lebar West for office-edge energy, and Geylang East when nightlife adjacency is intentional.
